Claim 1 (Currently Amended): An immunogenic composition comprising: a modified, live bovine viral diarrhea virus type lb (BVDV-lb), [[and ]]a veterinary-acceptable carrier, and optionally an adjuvant, wherein the modified, live bovine viral diarrhea virus type lb (BVDV-lb) is not a composition that encompasses BVDV Type 1a or Type 2.

Claim 3 (Currently Amended): The immunogenic composition of claim 1, further comprising one or more of a parainfluenza virus Type 3 (PI3), a bovine respiratory syncytial virus (BRSV), a bovine herpes virus (BHV-1), or an infectious bovine rhinotracheitis (IBR) virus, or any combination thereof; or one or more viral-specific antigens obtained therefrom, wherein the immunogenic composition does not include a cytopathic BVDV-lb virus.

Claim 4 (Currently Amended): The immunogenic composition of claim 1, further comprising a modified, live IBRV, a modified, live BRSV, a modified, live BHV-1, or a modified, live PI3, or a combination thereof, wherein the immunogenic composition does not include a cytopathic BVDV-lb virus.

Claim 6 (Currently Amended): The immunogenic composition of claim 1, further comprising an immunologically effective amount of at least a first antigen, wherein the immunogenic composition does not include a cytopathic BVDV-lb virus.

Claim 12 (Currently Amended): The vaccine of claim [[11]]4, further comprising an immunologically-effective amount of a least one microbial pathogen-specific antigen, wherein the immunogenic composition does not include a cytopathic BVDV-lb virus.
